subject: MAP kickoff  first draft of milestones, owners, and target close windows (Hedgestone)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Torres <megan@hedgestone.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff  first draft of milestones, owners, and target close windows (Hedgestone)

Megan  thanks again for the great discovery conversation today. Quick recap and an initial Mutual Action Plan (attached) so we can align on milestones, owners, and a realistic close window. High level below; please confirm stakeholders and call out any missing dependencies.

Key business goals we captured
- Reduce per-inference cost for batch scoring by ~45% through quantized serving and optimized batching
- Guarantee p95 inference latency under 150ms for live customer-facing workflows

Initial MAP (attached: Hedgestone_MAP_v1.xlsx)  milestones & owners
1) Pilot setup (env + sandbox model): Hedgestone infra lead + Redwood Solutions  target: 2 weeks from kickoff
2) Integration of SSO & network allowlist: Hedgestone security (Carlos)  target: 3 weeks
3) Pilot validation (quality + perf): Hedgestone data team + Redwood ML Eng (Aditya)  target: 5 weeks
4) Procurement & contract sign-off: Hedgestone procurement (Megan) + Redwood Sales  target close window: 6-8 weeks

Two timeline options (pick one or propose your own)
- Option A (aggressive): Kickoff next week, pilot complete in 5 weeks, contract by week 6  requires procurement review expedited and priority infra access
- Option B (conservative): Kickoff in two weeks, pilot complete in 7 weeks, contract by week 9  builds in procurement and security review buffer

Dependencies we flagged
- Procurement PO and standard T&Cs review (Hedgestone)
- Network allowlist and firewall exceptions (network/security teams)
- Dataset samples for pilot (Hedgestone data team)

Ask
- Please confirm who should be listed as owners for each milestone (I added Carlos for security; if that's incorrect please update).
- Which timeline option feels realistic? If neither, propose target weeks.
- Can you add the procurement contact (name & email) so we can route contract drafts?

Next steps from our side
- Ill update the attached MAP with any changes you send and share a calendar invite for a 30-min kickoff next week once owners are confirmed.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jasmine@redwood.ai]
Attachment: Hedgestone_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: discovery-notes-20270620.pdf (notes)

From: Megan Torres <megan@hedgestone.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@hedgestone.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff  first draft of milestones, owners, and target close windows (Hedgestone)

Jasmine  thanks for the clear recap and the draft MAP. Helpful. A few quick notes:
- Please add Carlos Rivera (ccd) as the security owner  hell take point on allowlist and compliance checks.
- Procurement: Im the initial procurement contact but final PO approval will come from our VP of Finance (Elena Park, elena.park@hedgestone.com). Can you add Elena to the procurement line-item?
- Timeline: Option B looks much more realistic given our internal quarterly freeze next week. If we start the kickoff the week of July 5, target contract sign by end of August (approx 8-9 weeks).

Also: we have a standard vendor security questionnaire that Carlos will route. That will be one of the gating items for a pilot.

Happy to kick off a 30-min call  suggest July 6 or 7 morning PT.

Best,
Megan Torres
Head of Partnerships, Hedgestone Financial
[megan@hedgestone.com]

From: Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@hedgestone.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>, Megan Torres <megan@hedgestone.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff  first draft of milestones, owners, and target close windows (Hedgestone)

Thanks Jasmine  adding a few security items to the MAP:
- Required: Completed vendor security questionnaire (I will send)
- Required: Network allowlist + IP range confirmation
- Optional: SOC 2 report (we may ask during procurement)

I'll coordinate with our infra team on the firewall rules and will share the contact for the procurement approver separately. July 6 AM PT works for me.

- Carlos
Security Lead, Hedgestone

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Torres <megan@hedgestone.com>, Carlos Rivera <c.rivera@hedgestone.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff  first draft of milestones, owners, and target close windows (Hedgestone)

Perfect  thanks everyone. I updated the attached MAP to reflect: Carlos as security owner, Elena for procurement approver, and Option B timeline with kickoff the week of July 5.

Ill send a calendar invite for July 6 at 9:30 AM PT and include a short agenda: 1) confirm owners, 2) walk through pilot scope, 3) deliverable checklist for pilot dataset and access. If that time doesn't work, let me know and I can shift to the 7th.

Attachments: Hedgestone_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), discovery-notes-20270620.pdf (annotated)
